body:
User asked (verbatim):
  commit and push all

  and publish new version with store listing

Context:
  Pushed 502a016 (all work incl. sign-in gate, Allow on all sites, pass-through hosts, Settings sidebar, compact popup). Store had 0.3.0 submitted 2026-10-07. Versioning rule rul_01a124a9ee157756843f9646d6340fb1: patch bumps, so 0.3.1. Must-rule rul_01a106d3f0d07799be3d140f90cc5c88: update listing (screenshots in brand/store/, description) in the dashboard first, confirm with the user, then cws:publish.

Acceptance:
  0.3.1 uploaded with an up-to-date listing (description + screenshots), user confirms, then submitted for review.
title: Release 0.3.1 with refreshed Store listing
